$comment: HAND-EDITED source of the Chats settings (cx-d5b5d); gen-settings-sources.py writes the Swift descriptors and parser constants. Row fields: see schemas/settings/source/updates.json.

lists.name: chats
lists.note: Device-local chat indexing controls (enabled, discovery and roots are privacy decisions for the person) and the session recap, which spends the person's usage. The default `cmux chat` target is a CLI default the person may ask an agent to set.

help.text: Show chats stored on this device. Nothing is uploaded.
Find harness chat folders automatically. When off, only the listed folders are used.

summary.text: Extra folders to read chats from

help.text: A line on where a Claude chat stands when you come back. Each is a small model call.

rows.name: coldArchive
rows.note: Off by default (Leo, 2026-11-09: "potentially auto compress old history to save disk? some sort of cold archival thing"). On: the acpmux daemon moves the log of every chat idle for coldArchiveAfterDays into one zstd file and keeps a preview (title, last messages, sizes) in the chat list; opening the chat brings the log back byte for byte (cmux-tui acpmux hub/cold_archive.rs, read from the settings file at each pass).

help.text: Unused chats are compressed into one small file each and open as before.

rows.name: coldArchiveAfterDays
rows.note: Days with no new record and no change before Compress Old Chats compresses a chat. 30 by default.

help.text: Days unused before a chat is compressed. Busy chats never are.

rows.name: deleteHistoryAfterDays
rows.note: 0 (never) by default: nothing is deleted, as before. The customization matrix row history-retention (Claude Code cleanupPeriodDays, Codex history.persistence). A number of days: the acpmux daemon's retention worker deletes every closed chat (or cold-archived idle one) with no record and no change for that long, as `acpmux session rm` does; never one that is open, pinned, running, attached or busy. Irreversible. Read from the settings file at each pass (cmux-tui acpmux hub/history_delete.rs).

help.text: Permanently deletes closed chats unused for this many days. 0 never deletes.

rows.name: archiveInactive
rows.note: Never by default (Leo, 2026-11-18: "there's the archived/settled chats for it, etc", the Claude app's Archive inactive sessions). A number of days: the acpmux daemon archives every chat with no activity for that long (tags archived=<ms> and archivedBy=auto), never one that is running or waiting, has background commands or subagents, is pinned or is a side chat; a pass every 10 minutes, read from the settings file at each pass (cmux-tui acpmux hub/inactive_archive.rs). The daemon also reads a plain number of days.

help.text: Archives chats after a period of no activity. Chats that are running or have background work never are.

rows.name: coldSegments
rows.note: Off by default while it is reviewed (Leo: "dont delete automatically but maybe we can add an option for people to opt in release old chats if theyre really idle and old or store them"; lossless compression of history is allowed, deleting it is not). On: as a chat's 8 MiB log segment seals, the acpmux daemon's one worker compresses it into the chat's cold-segments/ folder as checksummed zstd frames, verifies the archive against the segment's SHA-256, then removes the plain segment; the chat pages back through the frames as before. Measured at 100k rows: 152.1 MB local before (scripts/measure/chat-cold-segments.py). Off stops new moves; segments already compressed stay readable, and `cmux chats warm` (acpmux `_acpmux/chats_warm`) brings them all back as plain files, checked byte for byte (cmux-tui acpmux store/cold_segments.rs, hub/cold_segments.rs, read from the settings file at each pass).

help.text: Compresses the older parts of long chats. Run cmux chats warm to undo.

rows.name: coldSegmentsLevel
rows.note: The zstd level Compress Long Chats uses, 1 to 19; 3 by default (7.11 MB for a 100k-row chat at level 3, measured by scripts/measure/chat-cold-segments.py). Higher is smaller and slower to write; reading back costs about the same.

help.text: Higher levels use less disk and take longer to compress.

rows.name: chatOn
rows.note: The default target of `cmux chat` (cli/chat_start.rs): here, cloud, vm:new, vm:ID|NAME, or a device id or name. `--on` and then CMUX_ON come first; empty is here. The CLI reads it through settings.get only when both are absent, and `cmux config set on TARGET` is the CLI's short name for this key (cli/app/settings.rs). Leo, 2026-11-07: "cmux chat is normal, and cmux chat with the flag/arguments can separate if you want it on a different device/vm/cloud/whatevret".

help.text: Where cmux chat starts a chat with no --on: here, cloud, vm:NAME or a device name.
